description: Quick rug and honeypot check on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon or Solana: 0-100 risk score, level, summary, top 3 reasons, pass/warn/fail per check, and a simulated buy and sell (can it be sold, buy/sell tax; nothing is sent). /token ($0.01) adds every reason, the facts, the deployer's launches and change tracking. Not advice. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.
